requirements.statement: Freeze a closed byte-exact provider-dispatch protocol, schemas, golden vectors, and a non-production fake broker.
Authorize one exact final provider request with authenticator-internal FIDO2 user verification and no reusable run-wide grant.
Keep the OpenRouter credential and network transport exclusively inside the broker process.
Use fixed trusted endpoint discovery and independently authenticated local client eligibility without caller-provided socket paths or environment authorization.
Bind payload, destination, model order, repository, run, lane, candidate, nonce, issuance, expiry, policy, scanner, and result key into the exact authorization exchange.
Reject replay, stale authorization, downgrade, cross-connection resume, cancellation takeover, and altered request state fail closed.
Replace only Depot's host_authority_unavailable assessment seam while preserving the existing routing matrix and Codex fallback before provider contact.
Provide Linux-first daemon, client, systemd socket activation, status, installation, recovery, and uninstallation artifacts without performing a live install.
Prove the complete slice with hostile offline integration tests using fake FIDO, fixture credentials, fixed test sockets, and a local TLS provider fixture.
Keep live installation, real credential provisioning, FIDO enrollment, provider contact, publication, macOS parity, and broader rollout behind explicit later authorization gates.

prohibited_regressions.statement: Pipeline, dm-review, assessment, research, and adversarial lanes must continue falling back to Codex before unauthorized provider contact.
Direct interactive OpenRouter dispatch must remain exact-digest gated.
Dry-run routing and the dormant OpenRouter executor must remain intact.
Authority keys and provider credentials must not enter repository files, worker-readable files, stdout, logs, argv, environment, crash reports, receipts, or fixtures.
Offline validation must not install or enable a service, enroll a real authenticator, contact OpenRouter, mutate another worktree, or publish git state.

revision_justification.summary: Initial approved Linux M0-M1 authority-broker verification boundary.
